{{Dablink|For other uses of the word "daughter," see [[Daughter]].}}
The '''Daughters of Silence''' was a group formed in the year {{ne|794}} by two former [[Accepted]] who were put out of the [[White Tower]]. They gathered twenty-three [[wilder]]s and organized, taught and trained them in the [[One Power|Power]]. When the [[Aes Sedai]] discovered them in the year {{ne|798}}, they disbanded the group, enrolled the "students" in the Tower as [[novice]]s and punished the two former Accepted who started the group.{{ref/book|7|30}} The punishment was severe and public to make sure that the lesson was carried to everyone who might entertain the thought of channelers outside of the Tower banding together.{{ref|Aes Sedai make the exception of the [[Kin]] since that group of non-Aes Sedai channelers helps locate and return runaways to the Tower.}}{{ref/book|8|Glossary}}

Only one of the women enrolled as a novice ever became full Aes Sedai - [[Saerin Asnobar]].{{ref/book|8|26}}
